melder.mutation_research.diff.strategies.label: PartDiffStrategy
melder.mutation_research.diff.strategies.role: Part-grain text comparison between two version materials: per common module, top-level classes/functions compare as individual code regions (added/removed WITH full text, changed as unified diffs, module-body residue as its own region) - the class-code grain of the derived-diff family (owner ruling 2026-07-11: the agent chooses module or class grain).
responsibilities: per-module part split incl. decorator spans; <module_body> residue region so imports/constants never escape comparison
parse errors report per module naming the failing side; text-less modules ride text_unavailable_modules
